Design an implementation plan for enhancing Rankora's team collaboration features, inspired by Manatal's ATS but adapted to Rankora's existing architecture.

## Current State (Rankora already has):
- **teams** table with owner_id, auto-created on signup
- **team_members** table with roles: owner/admin/member
- **team_invitations** with email-based invites, 7-day expiry, Resend emails
- **candidate_notes** with note types (general/positive/concern/flag), real-time subscriptions
- **tasks** with assignment, priority, due dates, status (todo/in_progress/done), real-time
- RLS policies scoping jobs/resumes/results/applications to team members
- Notifications system with task_assigned, task_completed, stage_changed, note_added triggers
- Team page at /team, Tasks page at /tasks
- CandidateNotesPanel component for notes on candidates
- useTeam(), useTasks(), useCandidateNotes() hooks

## What Manatal has that Rankora doesn't (worth adding):
1. **Team Activity Feed** - Timeline of all team actions (who did what, when)
2. **@Mentions in Notes** - Tag team members, notify them
3. **Guest/Hiring Manager Portal** - External stakeholders view candidates via shared link (read-only)
4. **Team Dashboard** - Stats overview (open jobs, candidates in pipeline, pending tasks, team activity)
5. **Granular Permissions** - Beyond owner/admin/member, restrict access to specific jobs

## Constraints:
- Stack: React 18 + TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind + shadcn-ui, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + Edge Functions + Storage)
- Path alias: @/ maps to src/
- React Query 5 for server state
- Sonner toasts for notifications
- Real-time via Supabase subscriptions
- Router: React Router 6
- Existing navigation in JobSidebar.tsx
- Types auto-generated in src/integrations/supabase/types.ts — DO NOT edit
- Edge functions are Deno

## Priority features to plan (in order):

### Feature 1: Team Activity Feed
- New page at /activity
- Shows timeline: member joins, tasks created/completed, notes added, candidate stage changes, applications received
- Uses existing notifications table OR a new activity_log table
- Filterable by activity type
- Shows author avatar/name + action + target + timestamp
- Real-time updates

### Feature 2: @Mentions in Candidate Notes
- In CandidateNotesPanel, add @mention support in the note input
- Type @ → dropdown of team members → select → inserts @Name
- On note save, parse @mentions → create notifications for mentioned users
- Mentioned users see notification with link to the candidate

### Feature 3: Hiring Manager Guest Portal
- New edge function to create a shareable link with a token for a specific job
- New public page at /shared/:token — shows job title, candidate list (name, score, status, stage)
- Read-only, no auth required
- Token stored in a guest_links table (job_id, token, created_by, expires_at, access_level)
- Recruiter can generate/revoke from job detail view

### Feature 4: Team Dashboard
- Enhance existing /team page or create a separate /team/dashboard
- Cards: Total jobs, Active candidates, Pending tasks, Team members count
- Recent activity feed (compact)
- Task summary by assignee
- Quick links to pending tasks

Design the implementation plan with specific files to create/modify, DB migrations, components, hooks, and edge functions. Focus on Features 1-4 in that order. Be specific about component structure and data flow.

138	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
139	  RETURNS trigger
140	  LANGUAGE plpgsql
141	  SECURITY DEFINER
142	  SET search_path TO 'public'
143	AS $function$
144	DECLARE
145	  raw_email   text;
146	  local_part  text;
147	  domain      text;
148	  base_inbox  text;
149	  final_inbox text;
150	  suffix      text;
151	  attempts    int := 0;
152	  new_team_id uuid;
153	  user_name   text;
154	BEGIN
155	  -- ── Profile & inbox (existing logic) ──────────────────────
156	  raw_email := lower(trim(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'email'));
157	  IF raw_email IS NULL OR raw_email = '' THEN
158	    raw_email := lower(trim(NEW.email));
159	  END IF;
160	
161	  SELECT inbound_email_domain INTO domain FROM public.platform_config LIMIT 1;
162	  IF domain IS NULL OR domain = '' THEN
163	    domain := 'inbound.rankora.co';
164	  END IF;
165	
166	  local_part := split_part(raw_email, '@', 1);
167	  local_part := regexp_replace(local_part, '[^a-z0-9.\-]', '.', 'g');
168	  local_part := regexp_replace(local_part, '\.{2,}', '.', 'g');
169	  local_part := trim(both '.' from local_part);
170	  IF local_part = '' THEN local_part := 'user'; END IF;
171	
172	  base_inbox  := local_part || '@' || domain;
173	  final_inbox := base_inbox;
174	
175	  WHILE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles WHERE inbox_email = final_inbox) LOOP
176	    attempts := attempts + 1;
177	    suffix := substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 3);
178	    final_inbox := local_part || '.' || suffix || '@' || domain;
179	    IF attempts > 10 THEN
180	      final_inbox := substr(md5(NEW.id::text || now()::text), 1, 12) || '@' || domain;
181	      EXIT;
182	    END IF;
183	  END LOOP;
184	
185	  INSERT INTO public.profiles (user_id, credits, inbox_email)
186	  VALUES (NEW.id, 5, final_inbox);
187	
188	  INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role)
189	  VALUES (NEW.id, 'user');
190	
191	  -- ── Team provisioning (new) ────────────────────────────────
192	  user_name := COALESCE(
193	    NULLIF(trim(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'full_name'), ''),
194	    NULLIF(trim(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'name'), ''),
195	    local_part
196	  );
197	
198	  INSERT INTO public.teams (name, owner_id)
199	  VALUES (user_name || '''s Team', NEW.id)
200	  RETURNING id INTO new_team_id;
201	
202	  INSERT INTO public.team_members (team_id, user_id, role)
203	  VALUES (new_team_id, NEW.id, 'owner');
204	
205	  -- ── Auto-accept pending invitations for this email ─────────
206	  -- Update team_invitations status and insert team_members rows
207	  -- for any pending, non-expired invitations addressed to this email.
208	  INSERT INTO public.team_members (team_id, user_id, role)
209	  SELECT ti.team_id, NEW.id, ti.role
210	  FROM public.team_invitations ti
211	  WHERE lower(ti.email) = lower(raw_email)
212	    AND ti.status = 'pending'
213	    AND ti.expires_at > now()
214	  ON CONFLICT (team_id, user_id) DO NOTHING;
215	
216	  UPDATE public.team_invitations
217	  SET status = 'accepted'
218	  WHERE lower(email) = lower(raw_email)
219	    AND status = 'pending'
220	    AND expires_at > now();
221	
222	  RETURN NEW;
223	END;

## Implementation Plan: Rankora Team Collaboration Enhancement

### Architecture Overview

The existing codebase follows clear, consistent patterns:
- **Pages** use `SidebarLayout` wrapper, `FadeIn`/`StaggerList` for animation, `Card` from shadcn for sections
- **Hooks** follow the React Query pattern with `useQuery`/`useMutation`, realtime via `supabase.channel()`, `(supabase as any)` for tables not yet in generated types
- **Edge functions** use Deno `serve()`, CORS helpers, service-role client, and `logSystemError` from `_shared/logError.ts`
- **DB migrations** are timestamped SQL files in `supabase/migrations/`
- **Notifications** go through DB triggers that insert into `public.notifications`, picked up by realtime in `NotificationBell`

---

## Feature 1: Team Activity Feed

### 1A. Database Migration

**New file:** `supabase/migrations/20260408100000_add_activity_log.sql`

Create a dedicated `activity_log` table rather than reusing `notifications`. Rationale: notifications are per-user (RLS scoped to `user_id`), but activity feed is team-scoped. They serve different purposes -- notifications can be dismissed/read, activity logs are an immutable audit trail.

```sql
CREATE TABLE public.activity_log (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  team_id     uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  actor_id    uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  action      text NOT NULL,  -- e.g. 'member_joined', 'task_created', 'task_completed', 'note_added', 'stage_changed', 'application_received', 'job_created'
  entity_type text,           -- 'task', 'note', 'candidate', 'job', 'member'
  entity_id   uuid,           -- ID of the entity
  metadata    jsonb DEFAULT '{}',  -- action-specific data (job title, candidate name, etc.)
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

Key design decisions:
- Indexes on `(team_id, created_at DESC)` for feed queries, `(team_id, action)` for filtered queries
- RLS: `SELECT` for authenticated users who are team members (via `is_team_member`)
- `INSERT` with `WITH CHECK (true)` so DB triggers (SECURITY DEFINER) can insert
- Add to `supabase_realtime` publication for live updates
- Create DB trigger functions that fire AFTER INSERT on: `team_members` (member_joined), `tasks` (task_created, task_completed), `candidate_notes` (note_added), `stage_history` (stage_changed), `applications` (application_received). Each trigger inserts one row into `activity_log` with the relevant metadata (job title, candidate name, task title, etc.)

The trigger functions mirror the existing pattern from `notify_task_assigned()` and `notify_note_added()` -- they use SECURITY DEFINER, catch exceptions with `EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL`, and extract context from joined tables.

### 1B. Hook

**New file:** `src/hooks/useActivityFeed.tsx`

```typescript
// Pattern follows useTasks.tsx exactly:
// - useQuery with queryKey ["activity-feed", teamId, filter]
// - Supabase realtime channel subscription on activity_log table filtered by team_id
// - Returns { activities, isLoading, hasMore, loadMore }
```

The hook should:
- Accept `teamId: string | null` and `filter: string | null` (action type filter)
- Query `activity_log` ordered by `created_at DESC`, limit 50, with cursor-based pagination (`loadMore` fetches next page by `created_at < lastItem.created_at`)
- Subscribe to `postgres_changes` on `activity_log` where `team_id=eq.${teamId}` for real-time new items
- Invalidate query on realtime INSERT

### 1C. Page

**New file:** `src/pages/Activity.tsx`

Structure (follows Tasks.tsx pattern):
- `SidebarLayout` wrapper
- `FadeIn` header with "Activity" title
- Filter bar: buttons/tabs for "All", "Tasks", "Notes", "Stage Changes", "Applications", "Members"
- `StaggerList` of activity items, each rendered as a horizontal row:
  - Left: avatar circle (actor initials, same pattern as `AssigneeAvatar` in Tasks.tsx and `getInitials` in CandidateNotesPanel)
  - Middle: action text (e.g. "Sarah moved **John Doe** to **Interview** in **Frontend Engineer**"), timestamp via `formatDistanceToNow`
  - Right: icon matching action type (reuse `ICON_MAP` pattern from NotificationBell)
- "Load more" button at bottom for pagination
- Empty state matching existing pattern (icon + text centered)

### 1D. Router & Navigation

**Modify:** `src/components/JobSidebar.tsx` -- add "Activity" item to `mainNav` array between "Tasks" and the settings section, using `Activity` (lucide) icon, with `isActive: pathname === "/activity"` and `onClick: () => navigate("/activity")`

## Feature 2: @Mentions in Candidate Notes

### 2A. Database Changes

**New migration:** `supabase/migrations/20260408200000_add_mentions_support.sql`

- Add `mentions` column to `candidate_notes`: `ALTER TABLE public.candidate_notes ADD COLUMN mentions uuid[] DEFAULT '{}';`
  - This stores an array of mentioned user IDs for efficient querying
- Extend the `notifications_type_check` constraint to include `'mention'` type
- Create a new trigger function `notify_mentions()` that fires AFTER INSERT on `candidate_notes`:
  - Iterates over `NEW.mentions` array
  - For each mentioned user_id (excluding the author), inserts a notification with type `'mention'`, title "You were mentioned in a note", message including candidate name + job title, and metadata `{job_id, resume_id, note_id}`
  - This is separate from the existing `notify_note_added()` which broadcasts to all team members

### 2B. Hook Changes

**Modify:** `src/hooks/useCandidateNotes.tsx`
- Update `addNote` mutation to accept an optional `mentions: string[]` parameter (array of user_ids)
- Pass `mentions` in the insert payload

**No separate hook needed** -- the team members list is already available via `useTeam()` which the parent components can pass down.

### 2C. Component Changes

**Modify:** `src/components/candidate/CandidateNotesPanel.tsx`

This is the most UI-intensive change. The approach:

1. **Props change**: Add `teamMembers: { user_id: string; email?: string }[]` prop (passed from parent which already calls `useTeam()`)

2. **MentionInput sub-component** (can be defined in the same file or extracted):

   - On `@` keystroke, show a floating dropdown (using Popover from shadcn) positioned near the cursor
   - Dropdown lists team members (filtered by what the user types after `@`)
   - On select, insert `@DisplayName` into the textarea and track the user_id in a local `mentions` state array
   - The textarea remains a plain `<textarea>` under the hood (no need for a rich text editor). The `@Name` is just text. The `mentions` array is what gets saved to DB.

3. **On submit**: Pass `mentions` array to `addNote.mutateAsync({ content, noteType, mentions })`

4. **Display mentions**: In the note rendering, detect `@Name` patterns in content and render them as styled spans (e.g., `text-primary font-medium`)

## Feature 3: Hiring Manager Guest Portal

### 3A. Database Migration

**New file:** `supabase/migrations/20260408300000_add_guest_links.sql`

```sql
CREATE TABLE public.guest_links (
  id          uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  job_id      uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  team_id     uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  token       text NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT encode(gen_random_bytes(32), 'hex'),
  created_by  uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  label       text,  -- optional label like "For VP Engineering"
  access_level text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'read' CHECK (access_level IN ('read')),
  expires_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT (now() + interval '30 days'),
  revoked     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

Key decisions:
- Token is a 32-byte hex string (64 chars), not a UUID, for better security
- `revoked` boolean rather than deletion to preserve audit trail
- Default 30-day expiry (longer than team invites since hiring managers need time)
- RLS: `SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE` for team admins of the `team_id` (via `is_team_admin`). No anonymous access policy needed since the public page uses an edge function.
- Index on `token` for fast lookup

### 3B. Edge Function

**New file:** `supabase/functions/guest-portal/index.ts`

This edge function handles unauthenticated requests. It:
1. Accepts GET with query param `?token=...`
2. Looks up `guest_links` by token using service-role client
3. Validates: not revoked, not expired
4. Fetches job title, and candidates: `resumes` joined with `results` (overall_score, summary) and `candidate_stages` (stage), filtered by `job_id`
5. Returns JSON: `{ job: { title, location, department }, candidates: [{ name, score, stage, summary }] }`
6. Does NOT return file_path, email, phone, or any PII beyond name -- this is read-only summary data
7. Follows the CORS pattern from `send-team-invite/index.ts` but also allows the app origin for the public route

### 3C. Public Page

**New file:** `src/pages/SharedPortal.tsx`

- This page does NOT use `SidebarLayout` or `ProtectedRoute` -- it is a standalone public page
- Extracts `token` from URL params (`/shared/:token`)
- On mount, fetches from the edge function
- Renders:
  - Job title header
  - A clean table/card grid of candidates: Name, Score (progress bar), Stage (badge), Summary snippet
  - Sorted by score descending
  - "Powered by Rankora" footer link
- Error states: expired link, revoked link, not found
- No auth, no sidebar, minimal chrome -- designed for external stakeholders

### 3D. Router

**Modify:** `src/App.tsx`
- Add public route alongside `/apply/:jobId` and `/careers/:slug`: `<Route path="/shared/:token" element={<SharedPortal />} />`
- This must be OUTSIDE the `MaintenanceGate` so hiring managers can always access

## Feature 4: Team Dashboard

### 4A. Approach

Rather than creating a separate `/team/dashboard` route, enhance the existing `/team` page by adding a dashboard stats section at the top (before the invite card). This follows the existing pattern where the Team page is the hub for team-related information. The sidebar already has the "Team" link; adding a separate dashboard route would fragment the UX.

### 4B. Hook

**New file:** `src/hooks/useTeamDashboard.tsx`

```typescript
// Fetches aggregated stats for the team in a single query batch:
// 1. Count of jobs where team_id = teamId
// 2. Count of active candidates (resumes in non-archived jobs)
// 3. Count of pending tasks (status != 'done')
// 4. Count of team members
// 5. Recent activity (last 5 items from activity_log)
// 6. Task summary by assignee: { user_id, todo_count, done_count }
//
// Uses Promise.all for parallel fetches, React Query with staleTime: 60_000
```

The hook returns:
```typescript
interface TeamDashboardData {
  totalJobs: number;
  activeCandidates: number;
  pendingTasks: number;
  memberCount: number;
  recentActivity: ActivityItem[];  // last 5
  tasksByAssignee: { user_id: string; email?: string; pending: number; completed: number }[];
}
```

### 4C. Page Enhancement

**Modify:** `src/pages/Team.tsx`

Add a new section at the top of the `StaggerList`, before the invite card:

1. **Stats Cards Row** -- a 2x2 or 4-column grid of compact `Card` components:
   - Total Jobs (Briefcase icon, count, "Active" subtitle)
   - Active Candidates (Users icon, count)
   - Pending Tasks (CheckSquare icon, count, links to `/tasks`)

2. **Recent Activity** -- a compact card showing the last 5 activity items:

   - Quick link to `/tasks` filtered by assignee (or just navigate to tasks page)

### 4D. Shared Activity Item Component

**New file:** `src/components/ActivityItem.tsx`

Extracted component used by both the Activity page and the Team dashboard's compact activity section:
```typescript
interface ActivityItemProps {
  activity: {
```

This renders the avatar, action text, and timestamp. The `compact` flag reduces padding and hides some metadata.

## Key Risks and Mitigations

1. **Types file is auto-generated**: All new tables (`activity_log`, `guest_links`) and column additions (`mentions` on `candidate_notes`) will not appear in `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts` until regenerated. The codebase already handles this by casting `(supabase as any)` throughout. Follow the same pattern.

2. **Activity log trigger performance**: Each action (note, task, stage change) now fires two triggers -- one for notifications, one for activity_log. Both use `EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL` to prevent blocking. The activity_log inserts are single-row, indexed, and lightweight.

3. **Guest portal security**: The token is a 64-char hex string. The edge function uses the service-role key internally but only exposes sanitized candidate data (name, score, stage, summary). No PII like email/phone is returned. Tokens can be revoked instantly.

4. **@Mention parsing edge cases**: Keep it simple -- exact match of `@DisplayName` in text. No rich text editor. The `mentions` UUID array in the DB is the source of truth for who was mentioned, not text parsing.
